value.rationale: The local leaf count and global Wiener index are standard structurally meaningful random-tree observables. The all-order exact mixed moment, strict negative-sign classification for n≥4, leaf-transmission excess identity, and sharp quadratic asymptotic quantify a genuine local-to-global association, beyond separate first moments. The formula provides a natural reference for finite-size joint-statistic approximations without relying on an arbitrary chosen graph or parameter slice.
